company_ids.name: Unified Social Credit Code
company_ids.about: 18 letters and numbers on the business licence; the last one is a check character.

sources.name: Company code check
sources.what_it_does: Spots a fake 18-character company code (it has a check character).

sources.name: National Enterprise Credit Information system
sources.what_it_does: Official company register. No API and heavy robot checks.

sources.name: Qichacha / Tianyancha
sources.what_it_does: The official register data through a company.

sources.name: Canton Fair exhibitors
sources.what_it_does: Did the company have a booth at China's biggest fair? The fair's own exhibitor search (POST appbuyerapi/exhibition/queryshop, as 365.cantonfair.org.cn uses it). Card 'Canton Fair'.

sources.name: CCPIT
sources.what_it_does: China's trade chamber (China Council for the Promotion of International Trade). Checked Nov 4: no public member list, so not built. Chinese sellers are searched in the Hong Kong chamber (HKGCC) instead.

sources.name: China Customs AEO list
sources.what_it_does: Trusted exporters listed by China Customs.
